name: katra
description: katra — a committed, rich-component dev log you write as you build, stamped by the commit it describes and served as a live page.

plugins.name: katra
plugins.description: Chronicle development work as it happens, in markdown committed beside the code. A draft is an entry with no commit hash, so there is no scratch file and no promote step to forget: start one when you start working, capture screenshots and before/after comparisons into it as you go, and the commit you were making anyway stamps it with its hash and diffstat. Entries embed compare sliders, galleries, video, callouts and self-contained HTML figures. Bundles a stdio MCP server exposing katra_new, katra_append, katra_capture, katra_compare, katra_stamp and the task/epic/decision node model.
